source: Figma file Design MCP › Layouts page. The brand team keeps adding references: page breakers, closing slides, fixed slides (product stack, team) and content-slide layouts.
rule: Keep each reference slide's layout and decoration as designed. Map only: background colour to the theme token, fonts to the nearest text style (14–72px), chips to the chip tokens, and the logo to its design-system placement. For content references, Claude may adapt the layout to the content, still mapping these four.

mapping.background: theme background token (background/brand, background/inverse or background/primary)
mapping.fonts: nearest named text style, never below 14px or above 72px (Display/XL)
mapping.chips: container/inverse + text/inverse, radius/md, padding spacing/8 × spacing/12, Body/XL Semi Bold, uppercase text
mapping.logo: top-right on the 52px edge; white on dark and brand, blue on light; size may vary

product_stack.figma: 13 · Harness — every capability exposed to agents
product_stack.use: Whenever the product stack is asked for, use this slide as designed (only the mapping above).

team.use: Default for about or team slides, unless the user gives feedback.

page_breaker.use: One of the page-breaker designs; more will be added.

closing.figma: 29 · Close — every factory will run on AI
closing.use: One of the closing designs; more will be added.

content.figma: content layouts on the Layouts page (e.g. 14 · knowledge flywheel, 20 · customer journey, 23/24 · GTM, 26 · plan)
content.use: Starting points for normal content slides; more will be added.

kinds.fixed: product stack, team — used as designed whenever asked for
kinds.hero: page breakers and closing slides — pick one of the designs
kinds.content: layouts for normal content slides — a starting point Claude adapts to the user's content
